providerUseCase: Offline cassava disease classifier applied to sampled video frames — CBB, CBSD, CGM, CMD, and Healthy

drivers: Current humidity supports foliar disease pressure.
Multiple rainy days may extend leaf wetness.

predictions.label: Cassava Bacterial Blight (CBB)
predictions.closedSetWarning: The model always ranks one of five cassava classes and has no validated non-cassava detector.
predictions.symptoms: Angular, water-soaked lesions on leaves delimited by leaf veins. Lesions turn brown and necrotic. Stem exudate (gummosis) visible on young stems. Shoot dieback and wilting of growing tips.
predictions.treatment: Copper-based bactericides (Copper hydroxide). Remove infected plant parts. No highly effective chemical cure — prevention is key.
predictions.prevention: Plant disease-free cuttings. Use resistant varieties. Avoid working in fields when plants are wet. Disinfect cutting tools between plants with 10% bleach.
predictions.severityProfile: Spreads through rain splash, tools, and infected propagation material. Severe epidemics during rainy seasons can cause 100% crop failure in susceptible varieties.
predictions.source: Verdier et al. (2004) Plant Dis; CABI CPC
